gloss: to conclude; to judge decisively; to determine

definitions.gloss: to conclude; to judge decisively; to determine with conviction
definitions.explanation: To make a firm judgment or conclusion about something. Carries a strong, decisive nuance — the speaker is stating their conclusion with authority.

examples.japanese: {有罪|ゆうざい}と{断|だん}ずる。
{彼|かれ}の{行為|こうい}は{不正|ふせい}であると{断|だん}じた。
examples.english: I concluded that his actions were dishonest.

examples.japanese: {専門家|せんもんか}はこの{絵画|かいが}を{本物|ほんもの}であると{断|だん}じ、{美術館|びじゅつかん}での{展示|てんじ}が{決|き}まった。
examples.english: The experts determined the painting to be authentic, and its display at the museum was decided.

notes:
A literary and formal verb expressing a decisive judgment. More authoritative than {判断|はんだん}する and often used in legal, academic, and journalistic writing. The ずる conjugation is classical and gives the word a formal, weighty tone.

CONJUGATION NOTE:
Conjugates as a ずる verb ({サ変|さへん} variant): {断|だん}ずる → {断|だん}じる (more common modern form) → {断|だん}じて (te-form, also used as an emphatic adverb meaning "absolutely").

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～と{断|だん}ずる: to conclude that ~
- ～であると{断|だん}じる: to determine that ~ is
- {断|だん}じて: absolutely, positively (adverbial use)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {判断|はんだん}する: to judge, to decide — more neutral and everyday
- {結論|けつろん}づける: to conclude — focuses on reaching a conclusion
- {決|き}めつける: to jump to conclusions — has a negative nuance of being hasty

RELATED WORDS:
- {断|だん}じて{許|ゆる}さない: absolutely will not allow — {断|だん}じて as an emphatic adverb

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {断|だん}じていませんでした
